name: VnStockFilterAndTrading
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'cd /workspaces/VnStockFilterAndTrading && if [ ! -d .venv ]; then python -m venv .venv; fi && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt >/tmp/vnstock-pip.log 2>&1 && nohup python run.py >/tmp/vnstock.log 2>&1 & echo "App started on port 5000"'
